translations.en: Beneath the sign were letters that looked as though a knife had carved them.
"This is only a warning!
Only those who believe in themselves succeed."
Many other words were carved there,
but they were too weathered to read easily.
There was a broken staircase leading down.
Go down
Leave it
It began crumbling on the very first step.
You narrowly escaped being buried alive.
You ignored the stairs.
The bottom of the staircase had already collapsed,
and it seemed utterly unusable.
You ignored the broken staircase.
There was a pile of fallen rocks.
Will you examine it?
You searched around the fallen rocks.
Between them, you spotted equipment
that seemed to have belonged to some unfortunate adventurer.
Will you try to retrieve it?
To reach the equipment,
you tried to move a rock aside.
But the rocks came tumbling down!
The equipment between the rocks
was no longer visible.
You ignored the pile of rocks.
But something resembling a purse rolled out.
You obtained @3r20,000G@0r.
A blue pillar of flame, seemingly an electrical discharge, rose from the floor.
Was it a monster's attack?
A charred board lay on the ground.
Something appeared to be written on it.
"Ahead, electri..."
Another notice had been attached as well.
"Installation in progress. Danger. Keep away."
The switch did not seem to be working.
There was a treasure chest before you.
Suddenly, it opened its mouth and attacked!
It seemed extremely hungry!
There was a burning smell.
It smelled like iron being heated.
You could also hear faint breathing.
From straight ahead, you sensed something like intense malice,
so strong that you could not ignore it.
An indescribably sweet scent drifted from the spring ahead.
It was a luscious, inviting fragrance.
All sorts of materials were piled up.
Familiar-looking levers and other parts lay scattered about,
perhaps materials for building some kind of mechanism.
There were unfinished control switches.
Had someone intended to make a great many of them?
There were signs of an orderly assembly line.
Finished control switches stood in rows.
Boxlike objects were stacked nearby.
Had someone been packing them in this cramped space?
Boxes were stacked in every available space.
A label was attached to a box.
"Destination: Kranrutze.
translations.note: Shipment destination uses the glossary-approved provisional romanization Kranrutze; no external spelling was found.

translations.en: Contents: Switches (outstanding delivery)."
These seemed to be switches
that had been left here without being shipped.
Large letters were written on the floor.
Were they some kind of directions?
"Transport Route A."
The wall bore illustrations showing the process
for making what appeared to be a switch.
There was also something like a keyhole.
The process for making a switch was depicted in meticulous detail,
suggesting how much labor and expense went into these devices.
Still, it was surprising
to learn that switches were made in such a way.
You filed the method away in your memory.
An inscribed tablet was set into the floor.
"Here we leave the possibility of eternal existence."
Was it referring to the spring before you?
"People must not drink."

translations.en: That presumably includes you.
translations.note: Source word can mean people generally or the Human race. A mixed-race party makes a literal player-race assertion unsafe; modal uncertainty retained.

translations.en: "If you drink from this side..."
The last part had been scraped away.
Important information never seemed to survive.
translations.note: Source wording appears typographically malformed. Context is a scraped-away warning; interpreted as a complaint that important information rarely survives. Meaning requires in-game review.
